reviewer_role: Nonproducer narrow PDF text/visual and recorded-model evidence crosscheck; not a new scientific review.
independent_actual_scope: Opened the existing final Poppler 144 dpi page5 PNG; did not render a new page.

Extracted page5 text from the new and previous public PDFs and verified that the only textual change, ignoring layout whitespace, is the documented model-disclosure replacement. This also preserves the reference text, role/harness statements, human-review record and rights note outside that replacement.
Compared the new displayed model and reasoning setting with the time-bounded extracted local configuration metadata for the original public-edition authoring/review roles.
Read and attributed the producer preservation/structure proof; did not rerun page1-4 pixel comparisons or original scientific audits.

model_checks.basis: Original authoring/review-time local Codex turn_context client-setting records, not current default configuration alone.
model_checks.record_count_note: Counts are stored model-bearing turn_context records, not API requests or necessarily distinct turns. Session metadata with no model fields is excluded.

producer_proof_attribution.evidence: Producer preservation proof, separately retained with its raw QA.

limits: This review does not reproduce scientific results or independently revalidate all five papers.
The model evidence establishes recorded client settings for the specified public-edition work; it does not establish the external source-DQB production model or a backend weights snapshot.
The old publication review remains historical evidence for its own PDF hash. The present verdict is bound only to the new PDF and narrow change described here.
Web compiler/collector integration, archive registration, candidate validation, CI/deployment and actual public URL verification remain separate.

metadata_rebinding.scope: Narrow follow-up after the new-hash independent-review links and explicit archive replacement were recorded. No PDF rerender or new scientific review.
